replicated_originals.reference: McCarthy & Skowronski (2011) You're getting warmer: Level of construal affects the impact of central traits on impression formation (Study 1b)

A.reason: The title and methods state a close multi-lab replication of McCarthy and Skowronski (2011) Study 1b, specifically its Warm/Cold x Near/Far interaction, using the same stimuli and materials.

B.reason: Asch (1946) is cited as the classic warm/cold paradigm that the original study built on. The replication's target is the construal-level moderation from McCarthy & Skowronski, not Asch's main effect.

notes: The warm>cold main effect also appears in the replication data, but the stated replication target is the distance x descriptor interaction from McCarthy & Skowronski (2011) Study 1b.
